answer: Admission auctions ration identity: only 200 slots open each epoch, with sealed bids. A raven carries one sealed bid per applicant, so bids cannot be cloned. Winners lock the bid for 20 epochs; 100 fakes need 100 winning bids, each about twice 30 days of earnings, far more than flooding votes pays. The window is brief as a comet pass. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards, while each stamp at the forge costs as much as the first.
